note: Notes on three layers of the resource map, asked by data requests 554 to 556 (docs/state/data_requests_done_line.md). The layer files and manifest.json are unchanged; built by warehouse/derived/resource_layer_notes.py.

oil_gas_basins.rule: a word or hyphenated part that is a US state's postal code keeps its capitals; 'and', 'of', 'the', 'in' are small unless first; every other word has its first letter a capital
oil_gas_basins.plays: oil_gas_plays keeps the publisher's own text (no str.title), so no play is listed

wind_capacity_factor.reduction_in_manifest: none: every row of the source at the source's own centroid (coordinates to 3 decimals, the capacity factor to 4); the state, county, cost and transmission columns are left out of the web file
wind_capacity_factor.reduction_all_roundings: none: every row of the source at the source's own centroid (coordinates to 3, the capacity factor to 4, the wind speed to 2 and the developable area to 1 decimals); the state, county, cost and transmission columns are left out of the web file

offshore_wind_leases.choice: none: both of BOEM's tables are listed where they differ; the layer is unchanged
